messages:
sam: quick sync: i'm proposing an ingress "shape estimator" for embeddings to help routing decide fastpath vs batch vs async. very small, deterministic heuristic.
anya: nice. what's the input/outputs?
sam: input = request metadata (total_bytes, max_dim, num_items). output = header X-Embed-Score (0..100) and optional split_hint. we'll also expose POST /v1/embeddings/preflight for clients that want explicit guidance.
li: what's the scoring function? need concrete math for telemetry.
sam: prototype: score = clamp(round((total_bytes/1_000_000)*40 + (max_dim/2048)*35 + (num_items/100)*25), 0, 100). integer ops only, single-pass. split_hint example: [256,256] or {"async": true} for very large.
carmen: telemetry concerns: do not explode cardinality. tags should be tenant_id and region only. sample 0.5% of request shapes for debugging.
anya: routing rules idea: score <=40 -> realtime fastpath; 41-75 -> large-batch shard; >75 -> async-batch queue + return 202 with job_id when client used preflight. fallback: quantized smaller model if batch queues are full.
li: API naming: prefer /v1/embeddings/preflight (no colon) to keep SDKs simple. also include schema example in RFC.
sam: agree. rollout: passive headers (X-Embed-Score) rolled to all. active preflight behind feature flag ingress.preflight.v1 and on 10 canary tenants. console should surface canary impact.
carmen: console panels: time series of avg score, p90 split rate, and scatter bytes vs dims color-coded by score. also table for top tenants causing splits.
anya: alerts: spike in embed.preflight.rejects or sustained rise in embed.split_latency -> page eng-runtime. also alert if preflight adds >12ms median ingress latency for canary.
li: runtime work: i'll add estimator in C++ ingress path. will make it opt-in via server flag and add a fast circuit to skip when ingress CPU>70%. keep allocations to minimum.
sam: thank you. platform: will you add the feature flag and dashboard tiles?
carmen: yes, i'll wire flag and mock UI. also we'll keep sample size for event stream small.
deploy-bot: scheduled canary deploy: ingress-shape-estimator to canary-ring-3 at 2024-11-21T04:00Z. auto-rollback if error_rate > 0.5% over 5m. :rocket:
anya: one more: if client opts into preflight, provide split_hint so SDKs can retry automatically instead of server doing transparent splitting. reduces server load.
sam: good point. i'll include split_hint examples in RFC and note transparent-splitting is disabled initially. i'll share RFC link shortly. :thumbsup:
